WebLLM 0.2.87, released under Apache License 2.0. See LICENSE-WebLLM.txt.

The local ES module is a minified bundle of the published package, which embeds WebAssembly builds of xgrammar and tokenizers-cpp (Hugging Face tokenizers, SentencePiece, Oniguruma), and its loglevel dependency.

The following notices are reproduced from the upstream published JavaScript bundle.

* Licensed under the MIT license.

The MLC WebGPU model library is the upstream binary at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlc-ai/binary-mlc-llm-libs/146ed9cd4b4062e967b017fd2291f7106b50599f/web-llm-models/v0_2_87/base/Qwen3-1.7B-q4f16_1_cs1k-webgpu.wasm.

Model weights and tokenizer are downloaded separately from https://huggingface.co/mlc-ai/Qwen3-1.7B-q4f16_1-MLC/tree/80b3abcec6c3b3f5355dc0cc99cc4fb578f192bc.

Qwen3 model publisher: Qwen. Model quantization and compilation: MLC AI. See https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B and https://github.com/mlc-ai/mlc-llm.

==============================================================================
Components compiled into the WebAssembly modules embedded in webllm-0.2.87.js
==============================================================================

This section was added by Avenquellis. It is not part of the upstream bundle,
which carries no notices for these components.

webllm-0.2.87.js contains two base64-encoded WebAssembly modules, of 727,906 and
3,479,304 bytes. The package.json of @mlc-ai/web-llm 0.2.87 names their
packages: @mlc-ai/web-xgrammar 0.1.27 and @mlc-ai/web-tokenizers ^0.1.6.
Versions below come from that package.json and from the source paths compiled
into the modules. Apache-2.0 components are covered by the Apache License 2.0
text in LICENSE-WebLLM.txt.

Module of 727,906 bytes: XGrammar
  XGrammar v0.1.27 (Apache-2.0)
  https://github.com/mlc-ai/xgrammar/tree/v0.1.27
  picojson, vendored in XGrammar as 3rdparty/picojson/picojson.h (BSD-2-Clause)

Module of 3,479,304 bytes: tokenizers-cpp
  tokenizers-cpp (Apache-2.0), https://github.com/mlc-ai/tokenizers-cpp
  Hugging Face Tokenizers 0.21.1, the Rust crate tokenizers (Apache-2.0)
  SentencePiece (Apache-2.0), a tokenizers-cpp submodule, with Abseil code
    (Apache-2.0) and its vendored Protocol Buffers lite runtime (BSD-3-Clause)
    and darts-clone (BSD-3-Clause)
  Oniguruma (BSD-2-Clause), built by the onig_sys crate
  The Rust crates listed below

Rust crates
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Except for onig_sys, these crates appear by source path in the 3,479,304-byte
module. Licences are the SPDX expressions published for each version on
crates.io.

  aho-corasick 1.1.3                       Unlicense OR MIT
  base64 0.13.1                            MIT OR Apache-2.0 *
  crossbeam-deque 0.8.5                    MIT OR Apache-2.0
  crossbeam-epoch 0.9.18                   MIT OR Apache-2.0
  lazy_static 1.5.0                        MIT OR Apache-2.0
  log 0.4.22                               MIT OR Apache-2.0
  memchr 2.7.4                             Unlicense OR MIT
  once_cell 1.19.0                         MIT OR Apache-2.0
  onig 6.4.0                               MIT
  onig_sys ^69.8.1 **                      MIT
  rand 0.8.5                               MIT OR Apache-2.0
  rand_chacha 0.3.1                        MIT OR Apache-2.0
  rayon 1.10.0                             MIT OR Apache-2.0
  rayon-core 1.12.1                        MIT OR Apache-2.0
  regex 1.10.5                             MIT OR Apache-2.0
  regex-automata 0.4.7                     MIT OR Apache-2.0
  regex-syntax 0.8.4                       MIT OR Apache-2.0
  serde 1.0.204                            MIT OR Apache-2.0
  serde_json 1.0.121                       MIT OR Apache-2.0
  smallvec 1.13.2                          MIT OR Apache-2.0
  spm_precompiled 0.1.4                    Apache-2.0
  tokenizers 0.21.1                        Apache-2.0
  unicode-normalization-alignments 0.1.12  MIT OR Apache-2.0 *
  unicode-segmentation 1.11.0              MIT OR Apache-2.0 *

  * crates.io records this licence in the older form "MIT/Apache-2.0".
  ** onig_sys leaves no source path, but the Oniguruma library it builds is in
     the module. ^69.8.1 is the range onig 6.4.0 requires; the module does not
     record the resolved release.

The module also contains the Rust standard library (core, alloc, std and
panic_unwind, rustc commit 05f9846f893b09a1be1fc8560e33fc3c815cfecb) and the
hashbrown 0.15.2 crate it uses. Both are MIT OR Apache-2.0.

Where a crate offers a choice of licence, Avenquellis uses it under Apache-2.0,
or under the Unlicense for aho-corasick and memchr. Other dependencies of these
crates leave no source path in the module and are not listed here.
